title: Amazon invests $5B more in Anthropic

sources.quote: In April 2026, the Company entered into a stock purchase and convertible note facility agreement (“Amazon 2026 NPA”) with Amazon under which Amazon purchased 19.3 million shares of the Company’s Series G-2 non-voting redeemable convertible preferred stock for approximately $5.0 billion
Separately, Amazon will invest another $5 billion in Anthropic today and up to an additional $20 billion in the future, depending upon certain commercial milestones.

explain: Amazon bought $5 billion of Anthropic shares in April 2026, at the same time as Anthropic promised to spend more than $100 billion on AWS over ten years. Amazon also offered up to $20 billion more later (a separate record).
